<details>
This PKGBUILD is a standard, well-formed package definition for oh-my-posh, a popular open-source prompt theme engine. The source is fetched from the official upstream GitHub repository (`https://github.com/JanDeDobbeleer/oh-my-posh`) with a pinned version (`v31.1.2`) and a verified sha256 checksum, which is best practice for non-VCS packages.

The build process uses standard Go toolchain flags (`-buildmode=pie -trimpath -mod=readonly -modcacherw`) with proper CGO flag propagation for compilation hardening. The package function performs routine installation operations: placing the compiled binary in `/usr/bin`, installing the MIT license, and copying theme files to `/usr/share/oh-my-posh/themes`.

There are no suspicious operations: no network calls to unexpected hosts, no use of `eval`, `curl`, `wget`, or base64 decoding, no obfuscated code, and no system modifications outside the package's intended scope. This is entirely consistent with standard AUR packaging practices.
</details>
